0.1.43: Fixed bundled WebView2 startup on PCs where the runtime path used a Windows \\?\ prefix and never launched.
0.1.42: Windows builds now ship a Fixed Version WebView2 runtime so Replayr can open even when system WebView2 is broken.
Shows a clear error instead of a silent tray-only process if the UI fails to start.
0.1.41: Instant Replay stays locked to the selected game when Alt-Tabbing away.
Game Audio stays pinned to the capture target across focus changes.
0.1.40: Fixed Instant Replay segment joins that could drop opening keyframes.
0.1.39: Cloud uploads support larger high-bitrate clips by requesting multipart URLs in batches.
Raised the cloud upload size ceiling to 8 GB (was effectively ~640 MB).
0.1.38: Windows title bar now shows a centered app name with a wider drag strip.
Settings updates view shows formatted release notes when an update is ready.
0.1.37: Instant Replay bitrate changes now apply through a guarded buffer restart.
Added encoder status visibility for Instant Replay diagnostics.
Wider window title strip for easier dragging on Windows.
0.1.36: Instant Replay capture integrity fixes for the rolling buffer.
More stable clip-save and capture session transitions.
0.1.35: Composed recording negotiates actual output size before encode.
Instant Replay High bitrate increased for cleaner 1080p60 high-motion clips.
0.1.34: Channel Mode controls with mono source centering.
Audio route polish for source balance and channel consistency.
0.1.33: Native selects polish across settings and studio controls.
0.1.32: Scoped clip delete so library cleanup stays precise.
0.1.30: Named scenes and layer order controls.
Overlay stacking fixes and cleaner save toasts.
